Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for agreeing to join our Nov 30 webinar (AI cost/perf patterns). A couple items to nail down so production can finalize the run and the simultaneous interpretation handoffs: 

1) Short intros: can each guest send a 1–2 line intro theyd like the moderator to read? If you can provide both English and a Spanish variant that will help our EU/APAC moderators. 

2) Speaker headshots and 1‑page bio (for slide lower-third). Attached: speaker_bios.pdf — please confirm/update.

3) Staggered intros plan: we want to introduce speakers in a staggered way so each is on camera for their own 60–90s setup before the demo handoff. That reduces cross-talk and makes it easier for interpreters. Karthik / Soojin, can you sketch a quick micro-schedule (start times by minute) and call out handoff markers?

4) Language mediators: Vanessa, can you assign who will act as the Spanish-language mediator for EU slots and confirm if we can get a dedicated channel for live captions?

5) Logistics: any special dial-in requirements or laptop language settings we need to coordinate ahead of the tech check? Id like to lock tech check slots this week.

Attachments: speaker_bios.pdf (stub), localization_tracker.xlsx (stub)

Next step: if we have the intro lines and confirmations by EOD Friday (20 Nov) I'll finalize the run-of-show and send to production.

Thanks —
Lauren
